description: Page categories in the order they appear in a notebook and on the site. in_progress: shown while the notebook is in progress. hidden: never shown on the site. rescan: rescanned when the notebook is completed. single: a notebook has at most one, so once it's scanned, later uploads skip it. Session pages also cover unused (crossed out) pages; blank pages can be anywhere.

categories.label: Front cover
categories.describe: The outside of the closed notebook, often with a volume label (title, volume, start and finish dates, owner). Scanned closed, the scanner's plain lid fills the other half of the scan.

categories.label: Inside front cover
categories.describe: The inside of the front cover board, usually plain.

categories.label: Title page
categories.describe: The notebook's title and owner, often with contact details.

categories.label: Table of contents
categories.describe: A table of sessions near the front: PROGRAM, DATE/EVENT, OBJ COUNT/HRS, PG #.

categories.label: Scales
categories.describe: Reference scales such as the seeing and transparency key.

categories.label: Session pages
categories.describe: Observing log sheets: a NEW SESSION block and/or object entries.

categories.label: Index
categories.describe: Near the back: every object observed, listed by catalog with its page number.

categories.label: Notebook info
categories.describe: The notebook maker's page at the very back: paper brand, page count, copyright.

categories.label: Inside back cover
categories.describe: The inside of the back cover board, usually plain.
